children: Activist hedge fund Jana Partners is urging theme-park operator Six Flags Entertainment
to explore a sale, the Wall Street Journal reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter.
Shares of Six Flags rose 5.6% in after-market trading following the report.
Reuters could not Immediately verify the report.
